title: Student V0.1 G5 R1 — App Experience repair
purpose: Repair only the application-shell learner experience around installed rich V4 courses, active-session hierarchy, compact per-objective progress and resume/recovery clarity, while keeping activity interaction presenters and scoring semantics read-only.
invariants: This stream owns application-shell experience only and must not redesign individual activity interactions.
activity_presenters.js and core activity semantics remain byte-identical to the common base.
A rich V4 course present in the learner library must never coexist with a learner-facing false 'Aucun parcours Atlas installé' diagnosis.
The legacy Atlas planner is not widened to rich V4 families merely to remove the false empty state.
During an active journey the current activity is visually primary; verbose objective detail is progressive disclosure.
Compact per-objective progress uses current objective state data and never becomes a second source of truth.
Objective state must be represented by text as well as visual fill; color alone is insufficient.
Resume, recovery, persistence and completion semantics remain unchanged.
The deterministic Learn-it build may change because product shell source changes; the new exact build identity must be recorded.
RESULT_SHA is executable/tested product-shell repair; EVIDENCE_HEAD may add only its qualification narrative.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP/main/G4/G5 authority binding and exact common-base ancestry.
Baseline reproduction of false Atlas empty state and pre-activity objective-detail dominance.
Browser proof that an installed rich V4 course never shows a contradictory no-course/no-Atlas state.
DOM/order proof that current activity precedes verbose objective detail in active session.
Compact per-objective buckets for every objective with accessible learner state text.
Progressive disclosure for detailed objective evidence, collapsed by default.
Desktop and mobile layout checks showing no activity displacement/overflow caused by progress UI.
Keyboard accessibility for any disclosure/progress controls.
Unchanged activity presenter blob and unchanged core semantics proven at RESULT_SHA.
Existing Student V0.1 rich-family/product regressions PASS.
Repository governance PASS and exact changed-path scope PASS.
adversarialTests: Do not solve the empty state by making the legacy planner pretend it supports every rich V4 course.
Do not remove objective progress entirely.
Do not put detailed progress back above the activity through a different container.
Do not edit activity_presenters.js to fix lesson/flashcard confusion; that belongs to Activity Lab selection and later integration.
Do not change scoring, activity response shapes, source content or showcase copy.
Do not add shell-only code to source_manifest.json unless it is already part of the canonical app build path and exact build evidence proves necessity; prefer existing imported modules.
Do not use screenshots alone as evidence when DOM/state assertions can be deterministic.
independentReview: This stream is authored independently from Activity Lab and Pilot Activity Policy branches.
It does not consume sibling result/evidence during implementation.
A later ATLAS-WP-054 gate independently integrates this exact result with other accepted streams.
rollback: Close the Stream A PR and delete student-v01/g5-r1-app-experience. Common-base G4 evidence remains unchanged.
